description: Primary keywords: slot-skin Skin the model to automatically generate background node groups. The background nodes fill the domain, and using this command, the nodes on the outer edges are automatically assigned to groups. Group names are generated as follows: The outer nodes are assigned a name based on their position components.

keywords.name: slot-skin
keywords.description: Place the groups created by this command in a slot named s. If this keyword is omitted, the groups will be place in a slot named skin. Nodes on the edges and corners can have two or three groups assigned. In these cases, a number \(2\) or \(3\) is automatically appended to the name.
